identitySignals: The agenda item is a Measure N (OUSD College and Career Readiness Commission) review of this school. Aspire's own website lists 'Aspire Lionel Wilson College Preparatory Academy' as an Oakland charter high school at 400 105th Ave, Oakland, CA 94603, with Oakland as its sponsoring district.
The school's page sits on Aspire Public Schools' official site, so Aspire Public Schools, a nonprofit headquartered in Oakland, CA, operates it.
ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer lists 'Aspire Public Schools' in Oakland, CA as a 501(c)(3) with EIN 94-3311088. Its website and home-office address match the Aspire contact page.
research.notes: The agenda names the school, not a legal entity. I treated the vendor as Aspire Public Schools, the nonprofit that operates the school. I did not check the California Secretary of State or SAM.gov, so the entity number and UEI are null. The contact details are for Aspire's home office. The school's own line is 510-635-7737, at 400 105th Ave, Oakland, CA 94603.

profile.summary: Aspire Public Schools is a nonprofit charter school network. It describes itself as a K-12 school system that prepares underserved students for college, trains teachers and shares teaching practices. Its Bay Area schools include Aspire Lionel Wilson College Preparatory Academy, a grades 6-12 charter school in Oakland.
